title: Buffer tape under a nonnegative shift
statement: Let $b,w$ be finite Boolean words and let $z$ be a nonnegative integer. The buffer tape storing $bw$, read at cell $|b|+z$, has the same content as the buffer tape storing $w$ at cell $z$.
